intro: Lesson 41: Revise At-Takathur and Al-Qari'ah together. Recite this week's ayat to a grown-up every day. Colour a star when you recite with no mistake; the grown-up writes their initials.

head: Star
What the teacher listens for
rows: I say every word in the right order
Each letter comes from the right place
Fathah, kasrah and dammah are clear
I sit nicely, start with isti'adhah and Bismillah
